text: Add leakage-safe sequential user features: before each target impression, aggregate the previous 20 interactions from that user into recency-weighted counts of prior long_view positives and negatives, concatenate these two features with the existing user/item IDs, and train with pointwise BCE using only events earlier than the target timestamp.
rationale: Recent behavior may resolve ambiguity that static IDs cannot, especially for top-five ranking. The experiment is testable with a bounded history and strict timestamp construction; evaluate primary as the selection objective and use per-user ranking diagnostics, classification separation, prevalence, score spread, and global-versus-grouped AUC to identify leakage or calibration issues.
